title: Read-aloud no longer restarts or repeats the start of a reply. Cause: your phone

owner_note.text: Read-aloud no longer restarts or repeats the start of a reply. Cause: your phone was still running an older Recite whose finished-reply step cut the stream and started over from sentence 0 (the phone log shows it, with no barge-in trace beside any restart), so it was not the mic hearing itself. The current code read the first sentences twice; now only the unread part is queued, and a sentence cut off mid-stream is finished, not repeated. New: an optional interrupt mode (the abc / graphic_eq button beside the ear in the Recite bar): "words" pauses only when Whisper hears real words, so a cough or bang does not stop playback. Details: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/playback-stutter/findings.md. Reload the phone to get the new build. Merge b0fce2e7f.
